note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: How many courses are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Courses

questions.question: How is the math course described?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT course_description FROM Courses WHERE course_name  =  'math'

questions.question: How many different degrees are offered?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT degree_summary_name) FROM Degree_Programs

questions.question: What are the names and descriptions of all the sections?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT section_name ,  section_description FROM Sections

questions.question: What are the names and descriptions for all the sections?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT section_name ,  section_description FROM Sections

questions.question: What are the names and ids of every course with less than 2 sections?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.course_name ,  T1.course_id FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Sections AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_id HAVING count(*)  <=  2

questions.question: What is the semester which most student registered in? Show both the name and the id.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.semester_name ,  T1.semester_id FROM Semesters AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.semester_id  =  T2.semester_id GROUP BY T1.semester_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the description of the department whose name has the substring the computer?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT department_description FROM Departments WHERE department_name LIKE '%computer%'

questions.question: What are the first, middle, and last names for everybody enrolled in a Bachelors program?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T1.middle_name ,  T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id JOIN Degree_Programs AS T3 ON T2.degree_program_id  =  T3.degree_program_id WHERE T3.degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'

questions.question: Find the program which most number of students are enrolled in. List both the id and the summary.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.degree_program_id ,  T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_program_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the program id and the summary of the degree that has the most students enrolled?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.degree_program_id ,  T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_program_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are all the course names of the courses which ever have students enrolled in?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id

questions.question: Find the last name of the students who currently live in the state of North Carolina but have not registered in any degree program.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county  =  'NorthCarolina' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T3.last_name FROM Students AS T3 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T4 ON T3.student_id  =  T4.student_id

questions.question: Show the date and id of the transcript with at least 2 course results.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.transcript_date ,  T1.transcript_id FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1 JOIN Transcripts AS T2 ON T1.transcript_id  =  T2.transcript_id GROUP BY T1.transcript_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

questions.question: What is the phone number of the man with the first name Timmothy and the last name Ward?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cell_mobile_number FROM Students WHERE first_name  =  'Timmothy' AND last_name  =  'Ward'

questions.question: What is the first, middle, and last name of the earliest school graduate?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  middle_name ,  last_name FROM Students ORDER BY date_left ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the first name of the student whose permanent address is different from his or her current one?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name FROM Students WHERE current_address_id != permanent_address_id

questions.question: When is the first transcript released? List the date and details.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT transcript_date ,  other_details FROM Transcripts ORDER BY transcript_date ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the last transcript release date?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT transcript_date FROM Transcripts ORDER BY transcript_date DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the different addresses that have students living there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT current_address_id) FROM Students

questions.question: Describe the section h.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT section_description FROM Sections WHERE section_name  =  'h'

questions.question: What are the first names of the students who live in Haiti permanently or have the cell phone number 09700166582 ?
questions.gold_sql: select t1.first_name from students as t1 join addresses as t2 on t1.permanent_address_id  =  t2.address_id where t2.country  =  'haiti' or t1.cell_mobile_number  =  '09700166582'
